svg.desc: The path so far, on GitHub. 1,431 contributions in the last year, 762 commits in the last year, 65 public repositories, 74 stars earned, 25 followers. Top languages by repositories: TypeScript 16, HTML 14, Python 12, JavaScript 10, CSS 1. GitHub since 2018, as of 2026-10-07.
